# ServiceNow documentation — captured 2026-08-10
# https://www.servicenow.com/docs/

The docs landing page renders navigation chrome only (New Features / Prepare for Upgrade / Available
Versions, plus release-family links for Zurich, Yokohama, Xanadu, and Store / Mobile Apps release
notes). No descriptive AI content is extractable from this page — recurring limitation, unchanged.

KEY LESSON RECORDED 2026-08-10: the family release-notes index
(release-notes/family-release-notes.html) lists AI applications as *topics* but asserts no version,
GA status or feature content. The productive surfaces are the **per-application release notes**:
  - release-notes/ai-control-tower-rn.html   (AI Control Tower — resolved the long-held GA question)
  - release-notes/mcp-server-console-rn.html (MCP Server Console — new Australia application)
  - release-notes/identity-rn.html           (Identity / Machine Identity Console)
  - release-notes/now-assist-rn-landing.html (Now Assist landing)
  - delta-zurich-australia/*                 (combined upgrade-delta release notes)
Read those directly on future ServiceNow scans rather than relying on the family index.

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change to this page; navigation-only as before.
